population.definition: Current observable eligible listings/asking market within the explicit source-qualified scope, not historical transactions. Private and Bank results remain separate; only the existing adapter branches explicitly exposing crossMarket support a cross-market calculation.
eligibility: Current observable eligible listings/asking market within the explicit source-qualified scope, not historical transactions. Private and Bank results remain separate; only the existing adapter branches explicitly exposing crossMarket support a cross-market calculation.

Except matching/configuration, adapter selected preference groups must positively match (any selected value within a group, all selected groups). Matching ranks evidence; configuration counts its full conjunction against the base.

Sale and monthly Rent never mix. Bank canonical reduction requires DIRECT_SALE, exact retained sale transaction, PUBLISHED lifecycle, valid source freshness/provenance and coherent geography/type; Bank rent is not fabricated.

At least4 distinct valid source-qualified IDs; positive finite P,L,C; n−3>0; positive variation/full rank and all uncertainty/influence gates. Range limits are explicitly committed and inclusive in this adapter.
exclusions: Missing, contradictory, invalid, unconfirmed or stale required evidence cannot become zero, a guessed value or a silently widened population.
No exact area from category/range; no construction-as-footprint; asking amounts are not realized transactions; canonical money identities and BCCR date remain explicit.

resultStates.empty: An established empty selected population has zero count and undefined numerical summaries; retain the engine-specific states below.
resultStates.zero: Zero counts and zero valid differences/IQR may be meaningful; zero/negative asking price or normalization area is not an eligible positive observation.
resultStates.invalid: Invalid input, contradictory identity, duplicate canonical evidence or mixed scope follows the existing throw/exclusion branch; no invented successful result.
resultStates.unavailable: Missing authority, current rights, coherent source snapshot, required FX or subject is unavailable/denied under existing guards; never a successful empty substitute.
resultStates.undefined: Missing ranges→explicit_area_ranges_required. not_established reasons include insufficient_observations, insufficient_variation, rank_deficiency, numerical_instability, covariance_unavailable, degenerate_uncertainty, ratio_not_finitely_identified, ratio_uncertainty_exceeds_policy, influence_stability_not_certified. Invalid observations throw. Fieller can be bounded, disconnected, all_real, empty, half_line or unresolved.
